changelog:
### Discord Companion 2.7.0

- **New Servers & DMs section**: every guild, channel, category and DM the gateway reports is now stored in local SQLite and rendered after a restart — no more raw snowflakes.
- **Unread & mention tracking**: `READY.read_state` seeds the counters, `MESSAGE_CREATE` keeps them live, and any channel can be marked read from the dashboard. Mentions get a red badge.
- **Live typing indicators**: `TYPING_START` is streamed to the UI with a 10-second TTL and per-channel names. Nothing is written to disk.
- **Voice timeline**: joins, leaves and channel moves are recorded with duration, alongside the existing live voice roster.
- **New local endpoints**: `/api/servers`, `/api/unread`, `/api/voice/history`, `/api/typing`, plus `get_servers`, `get_unread`, `get_voice_history`, `get_typing` and `mark_channel_read` over the authenticated local socket.
- **Still local-only**: no new hosts, no telemetry, and the token never leaves the daemon. Catalog, unread state and voice history live in `companion.db`.
- Carries forward 2.6.0: signed Windows setup installer, portable `discord-companion.exe`, and the universal macOS `.dmg` for Apple Silicon and Intel.

broadcast.title: Discord Companion v2.7.0 is Live!
broadcast.message: Servers, channels, DMs, unread mentions, live typing and a voice timeline now survive a restart. Everything stays local — no new hosts, no telemetry, no AI training.
